alienarena.name: Alien Arena

keys.//password: needpass is a bitmask: 1 a player password, 2 a spectator password.
keys.//mods: mods lists a server's changed gameplay settings, such as %ctf%insta_rockets; game is always arena.

alienarena.//modes: Servers send no game type; g_teamgame marks a team game.

bf1942.name: Battlefield 1942
bf1942.//queryPortOffset: Servers answer queries on 23000 for players' 14567.

keys.//mods: bf1942, or the mod's own name, such as xpack1 or dc_final.

password.//maxLength: A server's password holds at most 32 characters.
password.//refusedCharacters: The game reads its command line as + commands split at spaces.

cod.name: Call of Duty
cod.//protocolOptions: Version 1.5 servers list under protocol 6; 1.1 servers, which 1.5 cannot join, under 1.

cod2.name: Call of Duty 2
cod2.//protocolOptions: Version 1.3 servers list under protocol 118 and CoD2x's under 120; the version column tells them apart.
cod2.//foreignServers: United Offensive servers show up on Call of Duty 2's master.

keys.//password: CoD4X sends it only when a password is set.

deusex.name: Deus Ex
deusex.//queryPortOffset: Servers answer queries on the port after the one players join.

join.//arguments: The address is the game's URL; each option follows it after a '?'.

password.//refusedCharacters: '?' starts the next option, '#' a portal, and a space ends the URL.

eliteforce.name: Star Trek Voyager: Elite Force
eliteforce.//masters: Raven's master closed; the community runs these.

text.//colourCodes: ET: Legacy takes any printable ASCII but a caret after the escape; this is its g_color_table.

password.//maxLength: Info_SetValueForKey refuses 64 characters or more, so a longer password would never reach the server.
password.//refusedCharacters: kpded2 rebuilds "set password %s", so a space splits the value; iortcw cuts the command line at every '+' and ends a token at "//" or "/*"; both refuse '"', '\' and ';' in userinfo, and Quake 2 expands '$'.

jk2.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast
jk2.//protocolOptions: Version 1.02 servers list under protocol 15 and 1.04 servers under 16; JK2MV joins both.
jk2.//masters: Raven's master closed; the community runs these.

jka.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy

text.//colourCodes: OpenJK's table: ten colours, the rest black.

jka.//masters: Raven's master closed; the community runs these.

kingpin.name: Kingpin: Life of Crime
kingpin.//queryPortOffset: Servers answer GameSpy queries 10 ports below the one players join; their reply names that port.
kingpin.//text: Quake 2 engines mark coloured text with the high bit, which only their own font can show.
kingpin.//masters: Masters list over GameSpy's TCP protocol on 28900; 27900 is where servers send their heartbeats.

keys.//maxPlayers: kpded2 leaves its reserved slots out of maxplayers, so a server whose public slots are full counts as full.
keys.//mods: The gametype is the mod's own title ("Monkey Mod v2.1").

kingpin.//modes: In order: bagman sets deathmatch as well as teamplay.

launch.//desktopFiles: Only names seen on real installs; Steam's Kingpin.desktop runs a steam:// URL, which drops the connect arguments.

join.//arguments: Each its own argument: run-game.sh recognises a join by " +connect ".

password.//refusedCharacters: kpded2 rebuilds "set password %s", so a space splits the value; iortcw cuts the command line at every '+' and ends a token at "//" or "/*"; both refuse '"', '\' and ';' in userinfo, and Quake 2 expands '$'.

text.//encoding: Nexuiz 2.5 predates DarkPlaces' UTF-8; its high bytes are the Quake font's glyphs.

keys.//password: DarkPlaces has no join password, so no server sends this rule.

sin.name: SiN
sin.//queryPortOffset: Servers answer GameSpy queries on the port before the one players join; their reply names that port.
sin.//text: Quake 2 engines mark coloured text with the high bit, which only their own font can show.
sin.//masters: The only master that lists SiN servers; 333networks and OpenSpy know the game but list none.

keys.//password: SiN's GameSpy reply never says whether a server wants a password, so none shows as needing one.

launch.//desktopFiles: From Dominatrix's CD installer; its archive, which Steam and GOG owners fill with the game's files, comes with none.
launch.//installDir: Where Dominatrix's CD installer puts the game for a user who is not root.

password.//maxLength: Info_SetValueForKey refuses 64 characters or more, so a longer password would never reach the server.
password.//refusedCharacters: SiN reads its command line as Quake 2 does: '+' starts the next command, a space adds a word that set refuses, '$' is expanded, and userinfo refuses '"', '\' and ';'.
